footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to BrightView: after $43.2M of preferred dividends.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Sep 30, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue fell 3.4% to $2.7B in fiscal 2025 (ended Sep 30, 2025). Gross margin was 23.3%, versus 23.3% a year earlier, and operating income fell 14.2% to $135M, a 5.0% margin.
Net income fell 34.4% to $12.8M, or $0.13 per share. Operating cash flow was $292M and free cash flow $37.6M, versus $127M; BrightView returned $24.2M through buybacks.
sources: BrightView Holdings, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
